b: All our indicators are pointing to an incoming rough one.
Starting last night about 8PM all new customer acquisition fell to near 0 (impossible in a functioning system). This has remained consistent through the early hours today.
Spending 3500 a day on ads, it's mathematically impossible for a brand of our size to see zeros in this column, even at 3-5am.

Personal feeds on the platform are flooded with irrelevant ads, people's posts I've never seen before, and pages pushing things that happened a month ago. (Guardians lose Game 6 ALCS). This is the ultimate indicator that the targeting system is experiencing disruptions and your ads are showing in the same fashion.

Spends this week are 50% of budget. Luckily we set up cost caps and are limiting damage but Meta just isn't spending now, of course during holiday when we need the revenue and spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on inventory planning for demand increases.
Basically, since last Saturday, all metrics have been cut in half and stayed at that level for 7 days consistently. 3 days is a trend, a week is a new norm.
My expectations for November are a holiday month we can't recognize.
